content:
First wing: \(9 \times 6 = 54\) halls, and each hall has \(20+8+4=32\) rooms, so \(54 \times 32 = 1728\) rooms.

Second wing: \(7 \times 9 = 63\) halls, each with \(25+10+5=40\) rooms, so \(63 \times 40 = 2520\) rooms.

Third wing: \(12 \times 4 = 48\) halls, each with \(30+15+5=50\) rooms, so \(48 \times 50 = 2400\) rooms.

Total: \(1728 + 2520 + 2400 = 6648\).

\boxed{6648}
